hero.heading: What this component does
hero.description: A single glyph from the shared icon library. Size sets its pixel dimensions, Framed adds an invisible touch-target square, Name picks which glyph to show. Nested inside most other components in this file, from Button to Dropdown

rows.Description: 16px, for dense UI like table cells or inline text icons
20px, the general-purpose size used inside most components
28px, for standalone or emphasized icon use
Icon renders at its natural Size with no extra space around it
Centers the icon inside an invisible 40px square regardless of Size, useful for consistent touch targets or alignment
The key property. Picks which glyph this Icon shows, swappable to any icon in the shared library.
None on its own. Icon is a static graphic, any transition belongs to whatever component embeds it
When nested inside an interactive component, icon color typically swaps instantly alongside the parent's foreground/text color.
A static layout choice, not an animated transition
Every Icon instance must reference a glyph, there's no empty state. Swap it to any icon in the shared library
When embedded in another component, the parent usually locks Size to match its own scale and doesn't expose Name as a property, swapping the glyph directly on the instance instead
Usually left false when nested inside a component that provides its own padding, true is more common for standalone or bare icon usage
Icon has no exposed color property of its own, it inherits its fill from whatever context or token the embedding component applies

sections.title: Anatomy
rawTextContent: The SVG shape itself, swapped via the Name property. Every glyph in the shared library fits the same square canvas
Square canvas sized by Size, 16px small, 20px medium, 28px large
An invisible 40px square padding area, added only when Framed is true. No visible background or border
Inherited from context, not an exposed property on Icon itself. Confirmed by comparing the same glyph across different parent flavours
Some individual glyphs, like the default Verified icon, expose their own further Style property. Icon doesn't promote it, editing it means swapping the instance directly

sections.title: How to use
dos: Use Framed when the icon needs a consistent touch target or alignment box, like inside a list row or toolbar
Pick Size to match the text or component it sits next to, don't eyeball a custom size
donts: Rely on Icon's own color, it always inherits from context. Set color where Icon is embedded, not here

sections.title: Accessibility and content guidelines
items: Icon is purely decorative unless it's the only content in an interactive element, like Icon Button
When Icon is the sole content of a button or link, the accessible name belongs on that parent, not on the Icon itself
Don't rely on the glyph name, like Verified, to convey meaning to screen readers

rows.Description: 16px small, 20px medium, 28px large. No custom sizes
Always exactly 40px square when true, regardless of Size
Icon never stretches or scales to fill a parent
No fill token of its own, always takes color from context
No breakpoints, only Size changes the layout
